title: Message/set old_state captured outside create batch
description: In MessageSetHandler (message.rs lines 178-183), old_state is fetched in its own lock scope before process_create runs. Each process_create acquires a fresh lock (line 307). A concurrent Peer/deliver or outbox write between the old_state capture and the first create would advance the message state counter, making oldState describe a state that predates that write rather than the pre-call baseline. Chat/set correctly captures old_state inside the single batch lock that also performs creates (chat.rs line 213-298). Message/set should do the same — capture old_state and run all process_create calls inside one lock scope.
